requirements.title: Defined text semantics

requirements.title: Labeled batched search
requirements.statement: Multiple patterns share one eligible input read and preserve per-pattern identity and multiplicity.

requirements.title: Powerful composition
requirements.statement: Search results feed SQL joins, anti-joins, grouping, bounded proximity and interpretation without an alternate search DSL.

requirements.title: Sound evidence
requirements.statement: Results carry exact locations and origin; absence is never inferred from an incomplete or failed scan.

requirements.title: Bounded resource behavior
requirements.statement: Read, memory, pattern compilation, context, result and state limits are separate; cancellation and cleanup are observable.

requirements.title: Safe source optimization
requirements.statement: Every accepted operation is applied equivalently; no lost residual predicates, invented aggregation pushdown or unsafe TAKE.

requirements.title: Agent discoverability and repair

requirements.title: Measured performance

requirements.title: Measured agent preference

requirements.title: Typed binary search

requirements.title: Installable product

requirements.title: Traceable execution

requirements.title: Cross-provider origin

requirements.title: Structural precision

requirements.title: Explicit incremental state

requirements.title: Single repository ownership

requirements.title: Immutable handoffs

waves.title: Lock the environment and establish a trustworthy baseline
waves.goal: Make every later result reproducible and prevent engine/plugin drift from masquerading as search defects.
exitCriteria: Commit an environment lock, authority map and documented non-destructive dirty-worktree handling.
Record actual tools/SDK/RIDs and target host observations; all absent prerequisites are blocked, never inferred.
Full required repository suite passes and original test inventory/log hashes are retained.
A fresh agent can select exactly the first eligible scope; no completed status can be accepted without evidence and a reachable commit.
Baseline/gate ADR is reviewed; local machine paths remain in ignored config and cannot leak into shared defaults.

waves.title: Specify the product and semantic contracts
waves.goal: Freeze the meaning of a search before optimizing its implementation.
exitCriteria: Schema contract documents each method unit, defaults, nulls, counters and SELECT-star fields.
A versioned semantics document and small reference corpus specify every case without depending on backend accident.
A resolved scope fingerprint can be explained and reproduced; no extension-filter rule incorrectly prunes descendant directories.
Negative answers specify their scope and completeness; no policy exclusion or budget exhaustion is silently converted to success.
Every proposal is labeled until implemented; examples have fixtures and expected rows, and the contract is reviewer-approved.

waves.title: Create a minimal vertical slice with correct lifecycle
waves.goal: Install, discover and execute a deliberately simple source before building a sophisticated scanner.
exitCriteria: A minimal literal search returns known typed rows through a compiled Musoq query.
Metadata is static for the plugin-owned schema and does not need to enumerate a path.
Observed engine/host behavior is documented, with required engine gaps blocked rather than hidden.
Faults are actionable and distinguish syntax, argument, source access, resource and output failures.
Vertical slice passes full suite and retains a compiled-query result plus lifecycle trace.

waves.title: Build independent oracles and choose the scanning backend
waves.goal: Choose implementation technology from equivalent-result experiments, not assumptions about C# or Rust.
exitCriteria: Fixture manifest records seed, bytes, expected units and platform-specific prerequisites.
Reference tests catch injected missed-boundary, duplicate-match and coordinate bugs.
One process handles multi-pattern rg baselines; no misleading comparison with N avoidable invocations.
ADR selects one production backend per declared dialect using measured latency, throughput, portability, licensing and maintenance cost.
Initial measurements and proposed parity thresholds are retained before optimization starts.

waves.title: Implement fast, reproducible path discovery
waves.goal: Avoid visiting and opening irrelevant inputs without changing the eligible search set.
exitCriteria: Traversal memory is bounded by declared frontier policy; counters and candidate identities match the oracle.
Enumerated candidates match policy fixtures and comparable rg ignore tests; pruning never drops re-includable paths.
Counters prove rejected candidates are not opened; path filters do not become subtree filters without proof.
Portable behavior is explicit; unavailable privilege fixtures are blocked for the relevant platform claim.
Agent-facing explanation states applied policies and counts without leaking unrelated paths.

waves.title: Implement the allocation-conscious literal scanner
waves.goal: Create a competitive exact-search path with no expensive row materialization for nonmatches.
exitCriteria: No row refers to returned pooled memory; active buffer ownership is bounded and audited.
Exact span multiset equals the oracle for randomized inputs and all chunk sizes.
SELECT Path FROM matches still duplicates Path per occurrence; files uses its explicitly different semantics.
Count results equal grouped reference occurrences; partial counts cannot claim exact totals.
Measurements demonstrate where parity is met/missed; no public speed claim or threshold relaxation without evidence.

waves.title: Make text decoding and coordinates precise
waves.goal: Preserve fast byte-oriented execution while making every returned location unambiguous.
exitCriteria: Strict/replacement behavior and original-byte mapping are defined; byte search remains the route for arbitrary binary input.
Coordinates reconstruct exact source spans and never label decoded offsets as original bytes.
Managed/native backends return identical results in their advertised shared profile or report unsupported combinations.
Policy-selected scope is reproducible; whole-file binary certainty is never claimed from a prefix probe.
Optional columns change cost, not which occurrences exist; supported validation guarantees survive fast paths.

waves.title: Add predictable regex and capture results
waves.goal: Support useful regular expressions without catastrophic fallback or ambiguous match semantics.
exitCriteria: Every rejected construct names the dialect and remedy; no silent backend switch.
Regex rows match the profile oracle and cannot hang or allocate unboundedly.
Captures can be expanded with APPLY; absent and empty values are not conflated.
No regex is truncated to fit an arbitrary buffer; unsupported streaming requirements fail or use a disclosed bounded mode.
Safe-profile correctness and performance report passes; backend/dialect compatibility table is published.

waves.title: Search labeled pattern sets in one pass
waves.goal: Turn repeated questions about one tree into one explicitly coordinated scan.
exitCriteria: No SQL map syntax or unverified collection argument is advertised; minimal and named-call examples compile.
One traversal and one eligible read per file per request, measured by counters; exact labeled span multiset is preserved.
No absence is inferred before the relevant file completes; counts/presence semantics are explicit.
Evidence records supported binding shapes; documentation includes only tested forms.
Report both scan cost and end-to-end investigation cost without claiming multipattern search itself is novel.

waves.title: Add bounded context and record-level interpretation
waves.goal: Return enough evidence to act on a result without scanning or serializing the whole repository.
exitCriteria: Count and match rows are identical with context enabled; retained bytes honor explicit budgets.
No pooled memory escapes; evidence expansion refuses stale source versions rather than returning unrelated text.
Every record has origin/start/end; no hidden parser guesses what a record means.
Cookbooks either use a proven necessary prefilter or explicitly label candidate-only coverage; parse failures remain observable.
An agent can obtain bounded evidence and expand it without trusting repository text as instructions.

waves.title: Implement conservative source planning
waves.goal: Push down proven work and keep the rest in Musoq without changing SQL meaning.
exitCriteria: Accepted plus residual predicates are equivalent to reject-all execution on generated fixtures.
Skipped materialization cannot change rows or leave required fields uninitialized.
All optimized results match the baseline; unsupported plans remain residual rather than pretending to optimize.
A developer can explain why a query opens a file, decodes text or cannot stop early; no invented HTTP endpoint.
Planner differential suite passes; no generic aggregate pushdown or CTE scan fusion is claimed.

waves.title: Scale throughput without losing lifecycle control
waves.goal: Use bounded parallelism and measured specialization while keeping output and memory sound.
exitCriteria: Workers, handles, buffers and in-flight result bytes stay within configured bounds.
Optimizations have before/after measurements and identical oracle results.
Backend selection and failure behavior are documented; no process-level unsafe truncation hazard is silently accepted.
Bridge/materialization cost is separately measured; no dangling memory or batch loss.
Throughput improves without changing semantics or masking startup, serialization or allocation costs.

waves.title: Close evidence, failure and resource contracts
waves.goal: Make every partial, absent or failed result interpretable by an autonomous caller.
exitCriteria: Terminal result has a sound state model even when there are no match rows.
Each report identifies its own execution; report lifetime and cleanup are bounded.
Every budget has a stable failure/partial reason; no arbitrary successful truncation.
No shell interpolation, automatic command execution, secret-bearing logs or safety claims based solely on ignores.
No atomic-snapshot claim for live trees; exactness is tied to an immutable input or disclosed observed read.

waves.title: Add byte signatures and bounded binary interpretation
waves.goal: Make binary search a precise substrate, not text search with an ambiguous numeric literal.
exitCriteria: Pattern compilation produces exact byte/mask sequences with actionable diagnostics.
ByteOffset/ByteLength and occurrence counts match the independent byte oracle.
Returned windows are immutable and budgeted; incomplete windows are explicitly marked or rejected.
Recipes use established APPLY-only parsing forms and preserve signature/parse error evidence.
No claim that binary support alone is absent from rg; added value is structured byte evidence plus interpretation.

waves.title: Build high-value relational investigation recipes
waves.goal: Make Search useful for real engineering questions, not merely a larger collection of flags.
exitCriteria: Result contains code, category, origin and evidence; tests assert findings, not just query compilation.
Recipe is lexical proximity, not a claim of language structure or control flow.
Output preserves candidate/proven distinction; negative claims require complete relevant scope.
No double parsing/counting caused by per-occurrence input; exact expected record results are asserted.
Every public recipe has a fixture, expected result, dependencies and a failure example.

waves.title: Make discovery and repair effortless for agents
waves.goal: An agent should learn the small surface, choose the right result unit and recover without guessing.
exitCriteria: Initial guidance is bounded; no catalog dump or misleading claim that every optional capability exists.
Mutation tests verify human/agent can repair without invented methods, repeated broad discovery or concealed data loss.
Development task results are recorded honestly; no training/holdout leakage.
Score correct tool choice including rg wins; report failures and confidence intervals rather than preference testimonials.
Target first-success, repair and token gates pass on designated tasks or remain explicit release blockers.

waves.title: Prove performance and reliability against release gates
waves.goal: Make the speed and usefulness claims independently reproducible.
exitCriteria: All mandatory suites pass; any unavailable platform proof blocks that platform claim.
Pre-registered ratio gates pass; unsupported comparisons are clearly separated, not excluded after poor results.
Report additive latency budgets and block unsupported streaming claims; engine/host changes go to the extension track.
No unbounded resource growth or cross-context data bleed; resource limits remain enforceable.
Reviewer signs correctness, performance and usability gates; no blanket faster-than-rg claim from a subset.

waves.title: Package and validate the first release
waves.goal: Ship an inspectable, version-compatible datasource without changing unrelated provider semantics.
exitCriteria: Registry changes match the evaluated project and current compatibility train.
All claimed platform artifacts validate against exact license/compatibility/integrity metadata.
Actual executable/provider versions, discovery output and query results are retained; no guessed machine state.
Release notes explain real differences and limitations; upgrades do not silently alter existing providers.
Core-ready milestone is recorded only with proof. Pushing tags, publishing packages/releases or modifying user installation requires separate explicit authorization.

waves.title: Adopt and verify the new engine contract in Search
waves.goal: Complete the provider half of fusion in its owning repository before the host adopts the combined stack.
exitCriteria: Versioned producer/consumer compatibility is recorded without silently equalizing unrelated package versions.
Only truly compatible scans can share; the absence of capability preserves independent source execution where the ABI is otherwise compatible.
One production scan can serve compatible logical consumers; one consumer stopping cannot truncate another.
Production fused/unfused results and old baseline behavior are validated on exact package tuples.
Original coordinated W21 closure is complete only when both engine W21-S05 and this scope are verified; no fabricated scan-sharing claims.

waves.title: Add Git-aware and container-aware origins
waves.goal: Search selected immutable or virtual content without unpacking an uncontrolled filesystem tree.
exitCriteria: No assumption that every provider exposes streams; supported adapters and exclusions are listed.
Working-tree and immutable-revision results cannot be confused; no checkout mutation is required.
Origin includes container plus entry identity; offsets refer to entry bytes, not compressed-container offsets.
Queries preserve provenance and produce explicit unsupported-origin errors.
Optional capability is advertised only after its own release gates pass.

waves.title: Add structural enrichment without pretending text is semantics
waves.goal: Use lexical search to narrow candidates, then rely on language-aware providers for stronger facts.
exitCriteria: Capability metadata does not label regex matches as symbols or references.
Enrichment adds verified node kind/extent without dropping valid candidates through an unsound prefilter.
Resolved identity has proof/context; semantic mode costs are isolated from lexical benchmarks.
Recipe output distinguishes candidate, syntax-confirmed and semantically-confirmed findings.
No blanket CodeQL-equivalence or ripgrep-speed semantic-search claim.

waves.title: Add exact optional indexes and incremental invalidation
waves.goal: Accelerate repeated investigations without silently returning stale or incomplete search results.
exitCriteria: State ownership and mutation commands are separately discoverable and never inferred to exist.
No false-negative candidate pruning; unsupported queries fall back to complete scanning.
Exact mode does not trust weak freshness; reconstruction/fallback is deterministic.
Never claim exactly-once updates or complete event history; stale results are surfaced or rejected.
Indexed speed claims disclose freshness/build costs; destructive cleanup requires explicit authorization.

waves.title: Evolve the agent-facing product using measured evidence
waves.goal: Improve sustained agent usefulness without turning a datasource into an unbounded agent framework.
exitCriteria: Each extension has a user task, success criterion and bounded resource contract.
Ranked absence is never interpreted as exhaustive absence; ranking does not slow exact scans.
Agents receive concise capabilities and exact repair guidance; no forced Musoq usage.
Measured workflow gains and losses are published; no invented preference or universal superiority claims.
The product remains a small discoverable surface with measurable value, not a growing flag/DSL burden.
